wiki.title: Mike Fong
wiki.extract: Mike Fong (Chinese: 方樹強; pinyin: Fāng Shùqiáng, born February 29, 1976) is an American politician serving in the California State Assembly from the 49th district, which includes parts of the San Gabriel Valley, including El Monte, Monterey Park, Alhambra, and San Gabriel. He was elected in a 2022 special election to replace Ed Chau, who resigned after being nominated to the Los Angeles County Superior Court.
